shots.headline: Keep the hospital moving
shots.sub: Patient flow from front door to ward bed
shots.scene: Town Hospital mid-shift (~11:00), Medium tier, campus cutaway with walking staff, bays and general ward busy, corridors mostly calm, HUD with stars and cash

shots.headline: Tag every arrival
shots.sub: Green, yellow, orange, red: colour + shape
shots.scene: Triage card open on a new walk-in: the four colour buttons with their shapes, a short queue at the front desk behind

shots.headline: Find the real bottleneck
shots.sub: Tap the lens, read the cause in one line
shots.scene: Bottleneck lens sheet open naming 'Discharges wait'; the matching corridor glows red in the diorama

shots.headline: Accept or divert ambulances
shots.sub: Take the bonus or protect a full ED
shots.scene: Ambulance call banner with Accept / Divert and the minutes-to-answer counter, ambulance at the bay, red-tag shape icon

shots.headline: Handle the chaos
shots.sub: Flu week, crashes, power cuts and more
shots.scene: Announced crisis running (flu week or highway crash): crisis card, busy orange/red corridors, surge team called (no rewarded-ad button in frame)

shots.headline: Hire the right teams
shots.sub: Nurses, doctors, porters, cleaners and more
shots.scene: Teams sheet open with all six teams and their hire buttons; one team pulsing because the lens named it

shots.headline: Grow to City General
shots.sub: Clinic to town hospital to city campus
shots.scene: Wide zoom-out of all three wings open: operating room, ICU, surgical ward and lift lit; 'City General is open!' toast

shots.headline: Hand over, earn your stars
shots.sub: Nine stars a shift for care, waits and flow
shots.scene: Shift report after a good day: star rows for care / waits / flow, treated count, net cash, Continue button (no ad button)

feature: Find the bottleneck. Keep beds moving.
